blocks.zh: 第六至七章：製劑技術轉移與品質管理面向
blocks.en: Chapters 6-7: Drug Product Technology Transfer and Quality Aspects

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解製劑（Drug Product, DP）技術轉移的範疇，以及無菌製劑相較口服固體劑型有哪些額外考量
blocks.en: Understand the scope of drug product (DP) technology transfer and the additional considerations for sterile products compared with oral solid dosage forms

blocks.zh: 掌握 DP 技術包（Technology Package）所需的核心文件清單，並能說明每項文件的目的
blocks.en: Know the core documents required in a DP Technology Package and be able to explain the purpose of each

blocks.zh: 說明 QbD 文件（QTPP、CQA、CPP、設計空間）在跨廠轉移時的實務挑戰
blocks.en: Explain the practical challenges of transferring QbD documentation (QTPP, CQAs, CPPs, design space) between sites

blocks.zh: 理解 ICH Q9 品質風險管理（QRM）如何在技術轉移專案中落地應用
blocks.en: Understand how ICH Q9 quality risk management (QRM) is applied in technology transfer projects

blocks.zh: 分析分析比較性策略（Analytical Comparability）與穩定性研究策略在技術轉移中的角色
blocks.en: Analyze the role of analytical comparability and stability study strategy in technology transfer

blocks.zh: 掌握 PPQ 策略的法規依據，並了解變更管理在技術轉移中的分類邏輯
blocks.en: Know the regulatory basis for the PPQ strategy and understand the classification logic for change management in technology transfer

blocks.zh: Chapter 6 — Technology Transfer of Drug Product（製劑技術轉移）
blocks.en: Chapter 6 - Technology Transfer of Drug Product

blocks.zh: 6.1 Introduction 6.1 簡介
blocks.en: 6.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — DP 技術轉移的兩種情境
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Two Scenarios for DP Technology Transfer

blocks.zh:
情境一：開發期轉移（Phase 2 → Phase 3）
在二期臨床確認療效後，公司需要將製劑工藝轉移至商業廠，讓三期臨床樣品與關鍵穩定性批次在商業設施內生產。這是法規要求的重要一步——三期批次必須代表未來商業生產的狀態。
blocks.en:
Scenario 1: Transfer during development (Phase 2 → Phase 3)
Once efficacy is confirmed in Phase 2 clinical trials, the company needs to transfer the drug product process to a commercial site so that Phase 3 clinical supplies and key stability batches are manufactured in the commercial facility. This is an important regulatory step, because Phase 3 batches must be representative of future commercial production.

blocks.zh:
情境二：商業後轉移（Post-registration）
產品上市後因產能、成本或策略因素，將生產移至新廠。此時雖然已有完整的 CPP、規格等資料，但轉移流程的嚴謹度不得降低——法規主管機關同樣會要求申報。
blocks.en:
Scenario 2: Post-commercialization transfer (post-registration)
After launch, production is moved to a new site for reasons of capacity, cost or strategy. Although the full CPPs, specifications and other data already exist, the rigor of the transfer process must not be reduced, because the regulatory authority will also require a filing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 開發期的技術轉移就像一家餐廳的試菜廚師（研發廚房）把食譜交給連鎖店中央廚房（商業廠）——不只是交出食譜，還要親自到場示範、驗證大量生產時口味是否一致。商業後轉移則像連鎖店把某一個店面的出餐作業完整移轉給另一個廠址，所有步驟都要重新確認。
blocks.en: A development-stage transfer is like a test-kitchen chef (the R&D kitchen) handing a recipe to the central kitchen of a restaurant chain (the commercial site). It is not enough to hand over the recipe: the chef must be on site to demonstrate it and to verify that the taste stays consistent at mass-production scale. A post-commercialization transfer is like a chain moving the entire meal service of one outlet to another location, where every step has to be reconfirmed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 視角
blocks.en: Key Point - The CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: 對無菌 CDMO 而言，最常見的情境是接受 Phase 2→3 轉移，或承接商業後轉移。兩者的法規風險不同：Phase 3 批次若失敗，影響臨床時程；商業後轉移若申報分類錯誤，可能觸發補充申請（PAS）而非 CBE-30，直接影響產品上市時程。
blocks.en: For a sterile CDMO, the most common situations are accepting a Phase 2→3 transfer or taking on a post-commercialization transfer. The regulatory risks differ: if Phase 3 batches fail, the clinical timeline is affected; if a post-commercialization transfer is filed under the wrong category, it may trigger a Prior Approval Supplement (PAS) instead of a CBE-30, directly affecting the time to market.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為何 Phase 2→3 的技術轉移時機對藥廠的臨床試驗供應計畫如此關鍵？
blocks.en: Why is the timing of the Phase 2→3 technology transfer so critical to a pharmaceutical company's clinical trial supply plan?

blocks.zh: 商業後轉移與開發期轉移在文件完整性上最大的差異是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the biggest difference in documentation completeness between a post-commercialization transfer and a development-stage transfer?

blocks.zh: 6.2 Technology Transfer Process 6.2 技術轉移流程
blocks.en: 6.2 Technology Transfer Process

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — TT 三大基本問題
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Three Basic Questions of TT

blocks.zh: 技術轉移的本質可以用三個問題框架：
blocks.en: The essence of technology transfer can be framed as three questions:

blocks.zh: 現況是什麼？（送方工藝的完整理解）
blocks.en: What is the current state? (a full understanding of the sending unit's process)

blocks.zh: 目標是什麼？（受方設施限制下的最終工藝樣貌）
blocks.en: What is the target? (the final shape of the process within the constraints of the receiving facility)

blocks.zh: 如何證明成功？（比較性、驗證、PPQ）
blocks.en: How will success be demonstrated? (comparability, validation, PPQ)

blocks.zh: 這三個問題的答案定義了整個轉移計畫的範疇與工作量。
blocks.en: The answers to these three questions define the scope and workload of the entire transfer program.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌製程的可行性評估
blocks.en: Key Point - Feasibility Assessment for Sterile Processes

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別指出，無菌製程的可行性評估不能只看設備清單，必須確認受方設施具備：
blocks.en: ISPE specifically notes that the feasibility assessment for a sterile process cannot rely on an equipment list alone. It must confirm that the receiving facility has:

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾系統與空氣分級（ISO 5/7/8）
blocks.en: HEPA filtration systems and air classification (ISO 5/7/8)

blocks.zh: 更衣規程與人員訓練體系
blocks.en: Gowning procedures and a personnel training system

blocks.zh: 環境監測（EM）基線數據
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) baseline data

blocks.zh: 滅菌驗證能力（高壓滅菌、乾熱滅菌、過濾滅菌）
blocks.en: Sterilization validation capability (steam sterilization, dry heat sterilization, filter sterilization)

blocks.zh: 這些不是「加分項」，而是無菌生產的最低門檻。CDMO 若尚未建立 EM 基線，技術轉移前必須先完成此工作。
blocks.en: These are not "nice-to-haves"; they are the minimum threshold for sterile manufacturing. If a CDMO has not yet established its EM baseline, this work must be completed before the technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 跨廠轉移的保密困境
blocks.en: Analogy - The Confidentiality Dilemma in Inter-site Transfer

blocks.zh: 保密協議（NDA/CDA）讓早期可行性評估像是「蒙眼猜物」——送方不能完全揭露配方，受方又無法充分評估設備適配性。實務做法是先簽署 CDA，再以層次揭露的方式：先分享製劑類型（液態無菌）→ 再分享關鍵參數範圍 → 確認接案後才揭露完整工藝。
blocks.en: Confidentiality agreements (NDA/CDA) make early feasibility assessment feel like "guessing an object blindfolded": the sending unit cannot fully disclose the formulation, and the receiving unit cannot adequately assess equipment fit. The practical approach is to sign a CDA first and then disclose in layers: first share the dosage form type (sterile liquid), then the ranges of critical parameters, and reveal the full process only after the project is confirmed.

blocks.zh: 當跨廠轉移涉及保密協議時，CDMO 如何進行初步可行性評估而不違反保密義務？
blocks.en: When an inter-site transfer is covered by a confidentiality agreement, how can a CDMO perform a preliminary feasibility assessment without breaching its confidentiality obligations?

blocks.zh: 面對面風險評估會議（Face-to-face risk assessment）為何比書面審查更有效？
blocks.en: Why is a face-to-face risk assessment meeting more effective than a document-based review?

blocks.zh: 6.2.2 Consolidate Knowledge for Technology Transfer Package 6.2.2 彙整知識以建立技術轉移文件包
blocks.en: 6.2.2 Consolidate Knowledge for Technology Transfer Package

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — DP 技術包的關鍵分類
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Key Categories of the DP Technology Package

blocks.zh: ISPE 的技術包清單可分為四類，幫助受方系統性地整理所需文件：
blocks.en: The ISPE technology package list can be grouped into four categories, which help the receiving unit organize the required documents systematically:

blocks.zh: 工藝理解類：BFD、PFD、製程特性化報告、開發報告
blocks.en: Process understanding: BFD, PFD, process characterization reports, development reports

blocks.zh: 管控策略類：批次記錄、CQA/CPP 連結、製程中管控規格
blocks.en: Control strategy: batch records, CQA/CPP linkage, in-process control specifications

blocks.zh: 材料相容性類：E&L、元素雜質、容器相容性
blocks.en: Material compatibility: E&L, elemental impurities, container compatibility

blocks.zh: 歷史數據類：SPC 趨勢圖、偏差報告、驗證報告
blocks.en: Historical data: SPC trend charts, deviation reports, validation reports

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 隱性知識的轉移最難
blocks.en: Key Point - Tacit Knowledge Is the Hardest to Transfer

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調「製程觀摩（Process Observation）」的價值——許多關鍵的操作細節不會出現在批次記錄裡，例如：「加入賦形劑 #3 時溫度會驟降，需立即攪拌」。這類隱性知識（Tacit Knowledge）只能透過親自觀察製程、或送方 SME 到受方現場輔導才能有效轉移。
blocks.en: ISPE particularly stresses the value of process observation. Many critical operating details do not appear in the batch record, for example: "When excipient #3 is added, the temperature drops sharply and stirring must start immediately." This kind of tacit knowledge can only be transferred effectively by observing the process in person, or by having the sending unit's SMEs coach the team on site at the receiving unit.

blocks.zh: 對無菌 CDMO 尤其重要的隱性知識包含：充填速度微調時機、軋蓋扭力的手感判斷、目視檢查的標準樣品庫。
blocks.en: Tacit knowledge that is especially important for a sterile CDMO includes: when to fine-tune the filling speed, the hand feel of crimping torque, and the reference sample library for visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌 DP 的特殊技術包項目
blocks.en: Key Point - Special Technology Package Items for Sterile DP

blocks.zh: 針對無菌製劑，技術包還需包含：
blocks.en: For sterile products, the technology package must also include:

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統（Container-Closure System）的規格與 CCI 測試方法
blocks.en: Specifications of the container-closure system and the CCI test methods

blocks.zh: 過濾器驗證資料（相容性、完整性、效率）
blocks.en: Filter validation data (compatibility, integrity, efficiency)

blocks.zh: 凍乾曲線（若為凍乾製劑）：各設施設備間可能有差異
blocks.en: Lyophilization cycle (for lyophilized products): equipment at different facilities may differ

blocks.zh: 無菌工藝模擬（APS）歷史數據
blocks.en: Historical aseptic process simulation (APS) data

blocks.zh: 滅菌驗證報告（含生物負荷基線）
blocks.en: Sterilization validation reports (including the bioburden baseline)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 身為 CDMO 的 TT 負責人，在收到送方技術包後，建議建立一份「缺口清單（Gap Register）」——對照 ISPE 清單逐項確認是否已收到。缺少的項目立即要求補件，並評估是否需要在工程批（Engineering Run）中自行產生這些數據。不要等到 PPQ 前才發現缺少製程特性化報告。
blocks.en: As the TT lead at a CDMO, once you receive the sending unit's technology package, it is advisable to build a "Gap Register" and check item by item against the ISPE list whether each document has been received. Request any missing items immediately and assess whether the data need to be generated in-house during an engineering run. Do not wait until just before PPQ to discover that the process characterization report is missing.

blocks.zh: 6.2.3 Technology Transfer Execution / Pilot Scale Batches 6.2.3 技術轉移執行 / 先導規模批次
blocks.en: 6.2.3 Technology Transfer Execution / Pilot Scale Batches

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 試驗批次的目的層次
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Layers of Purpose of Pilot Batches

blocks.zh: 試驗批次（Pilot Batch）有三個層次的目的：
blocks.en: A pilot batch serves three layers of purpose:

blocks.zh: 學習：了解新設備訓練下的製程行為
blocks.en: Learning: understanding process behavior on the new equipment during training

blocks.zh: 驗證假設：確認風險評估中識別的高風險項目
blocks.en: Verifying assumptions: confirming the high-risk items identified in the risk assessment

blocks.zh: 建立基線：為 PPQ 的比較性提供受方的製程數據
blocks.en: Establishing a baseline: providing the receiving unit's process data for the PPQ comparison

blocks.zh: 試驗批次不應等同「熟悉操作」，應有明確的取樣計畫與接受標準。
blocks.en: A pilot batch should not be treated as mere "familiarization with operations"; it needs a clear sampling plan and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌製程試驗批的特殊用途
blocks.en: Key Point - Special Uses of Pilot Batches for Sterile Processes

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出，無菌製程的試驗批應同時用於：
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly that pilot batches for sterile processes should also be used for:

blocks.zh: 過濾器驗證（Filter Validation）：確認過濾器與該配方相容、不吸附 API
blocks.en: Filter validation: confirming that the filter is compatible with the formulation and does not adsorb the API

blocks.zh: CCI 測試方法建立：確認密封完整性測試參數適用於受方設備
blocks.en: Establishing the CCI test method: confirming that the seal integrity test parameters are suitable for the receiving unit's equipment

blocks.zh: 目視檢查（Visual Inspection）規程制訂：建立受方的檢查標準與樣品庫
blocks.en: Developing the visual inspection procedure: establishing the receiving unit's inspection standards and sample library

blocks.zh: 這些在試驗批階段不做，等到 PPQ 才發現問題，成本將大幅上升。
blocks.en: If these are not done at the pilot batch stage and problems are discovered only at PPQ, the cost rises substantially.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 試驗批就像廚師到新廚房的第一次備餐演練——不是為了供餐，而是測試動線、了解設備特性、找出隱藏的問題（例如新烤箱的加熱不均勻）。在演練中發現問題，比正式開幕時出錯代價小得多。
blocks.en: A pilot batch is like a chef's first practice run in a new kitchen: the aim is not to serve guests but to test the workflow, learn the characteristics of the equipment and find hidden problems (for example, uneven heating in the new oven). Finding problems during the rehearsal is far cheaper than making mistakes on opening day.

blocks.zh: 在無菌製劑的試驗批中，為何「過濾器驗證」的時機不能等到 PPQ 前才進行？
blocks.en: In a pilot batch of a sterile product, why can filter validation not wait until just before PPQ?

blocks.zh: 若試驗批結果顯示充填重量的 CV 偏高，應如何決定是否繼續推進到工程批？
blocks.en: If the pilot batch results show a high CV for fill weight, how should you decide whether to proceed to an engineering run?

blocks.zh: 6.2.4 Engineering Runs / Pre-PPQ Runs 6.2.4 工程試製批 / Pre-PPQ 批次
blocks.en: 6.2.4 Engineering Runs / Pre-PPQ Runs

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Engineering Run 的法律地位
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Regulatory Status of an Engineering Run

blocks.zh: 工程批（Engineering Run）的定義非常精確：在 GMP 設備上、使用正式程序、全規模生產，但不以放行為目的。這意味著：
blocks.en: An engineering run is defined very precisely: full-scale production on GMP equipment using formal procedures, but not intended for release. This means:

blocks.zh: 它不是 GMP 批次，但必須用 GMP 設備和文件
blocks.en: It is not a GMP batch, but it must use GMP equipment and documentation

blocks.zh: 數據可用於製程理解，不可直接計入 PPQ 批次
blocks.en: The data can be used for process understanding but cannot be counted directly as PPQ batches

blocks.zh: 若工程批表現良好，可作為 PPQ 接受標準設定的參考
blocks.en: If the engineering run performs well, it can serve as a reference for setting PPQ acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — PPQ 前必須完成的開發報告
blocks.en: Key Point - The Development Report That Must Be Completed Before PPQ

blocks.zh: ISPE 要求在進入 PPQ 前，必須完成一份開發報告（Development Report），涵蓋：
blocks.en: ISPE requires a Development Report to be completed before entering PPQ, covering:

blocks.zh: 製程參數與設定值
blocks.en: Process parameters and set points

blocks.zh: 失敗邊緣（Edge of Failure）研究結果
blocks.en: Results of edge-of-failure studies

blocks.zh: 敏感製程步驟識別
blocks.en: Identification of sensitive process steps

blocks.zh: 管控策略的科學依據
blocks.en: Scientific rationale for the control strategy

blocks.zh: 這份報告是 FDA 和 EMA 審查 PPQ 報告時的背景文件，缺少會被要求補件。
blocks.en: This report is background documentation when the FDA and EMA review the PPQ report; if it is missing, a request for additional information will follow.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，工程批的資源分配是常見衝突點——客戶希望節省成本跳過工程批，直接進入 PPQ。CDMO QA 的職責是清楚說明：若無工程批就進行 PPQ，一旦 PPQ 失敗，重批成本遠高於工程批成本。特別是無菌製劑，一批 PPQ 失敗的直接成本（原料、人工、設施時間）可能超過 100 萬美元。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, resource allocation for engineering runs is a common point of conflict: the client wants to save cost by skipping the engineering run and going straight to PPQ. The CDMO QA's responsibility is to explain clearly that if PPQ is performed without an engineering run and PPQ then fails, the cost of repeating batches is far higher than the cost of an engineering run. For sterile products in particular, the direct cost of one failed PPQ batch (materials, labor, facility time) can exceed USD 1 million.

blocks.zh: 6.2.5 Process Qualification (PPQ) 6.2.5 製程確效 (PPQ)
blocks.en: 6.2.5 Process Qualification (PPQ)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — PPQ 的法規框架
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Regulatory Framework for PPQ

blocks.zh: 製程績效確認（Process Performance Qualification, PPQ）是技術轉移的最終驗證活動，其法規依據包含：
blocks.en: Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) is the final verification activity of a technology transfer. Its regulatory basis includes:

blocks.zh: FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance：三階段驗證框架（設計→PPQ→持續製程驗證）；無菌製劑通常需要至少 3 批 PPQ，且要求加強取樣
blocks.en: FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance: a three-stage validation framework (design → PPQ → continued process verification); sterile products generally require at least 3 PPQ batches with enhanced sampling

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15：歐盟對於 PPQ 的要求，需在正式商業生產前完成
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15: the EU requirements for PPQ, which must be completed before formal commercial production

blocks.zh: EMA Guideline on Process Validation：特別強調生物製劑的比較性數據要求
blocks.en: EMA Guideline on Process Validation: places particular emphasis on comparability data requirements for biological products

blocks.zh: PPQ 前置條件查核清單
blocks.en: PPQ Prerequisites Checklist

blocks.zh:
設施 / Facility:
  [x] 廠房資格認定完成（IQ/OQ/PQ）
  [x] 環境監測基線建立（至少 6 個月）
  [x] 空調系統認定完成

設備 / Equipment:
  [x] 充填機 IQ/OQ 完成
  [x] 滅菌設備驗證完成
  [x] 量測設備校正完成

文件 / Documentation:
  [x] Master Batch Record 核准
  [x] PPQ Protocol 核准
  [x] SOP 訓練完成記錄

分析 / Analytical:
  [x] 放行方法轉移確認完成
  [x] 穩定性研究方案核准
blocks.en:
Facility:
  [x] Facility qualification completed (IQ/OQ/PQ)
  [x] Environmental monitoring baseline established (at least 6 months)
  [x] HVAC system qualification completed

Equipment:
  [x] Filling machine IQ/OQ completed
  [x] Sterilization equipment validation completed
  [x] Measuring equipment calibration completed

Documentation:
  [x] Master Batch Record approved
  [x] PPQ Protocol approved
  [x] SOP training records completed

Analytical:
  [x] Release method transfer confirmation completed
  [x] Stability study protocol approved

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌 PPQ 的特殊要求
blocks.en: Key Point - Special Requirements for Sterile PPQ

blocks.zh: 根據 FDA 2011 指南，無菌製劑 PPQ 除一般要求外，還需：
blocks.en: According to the FDA 2011 guidance, PPQ for sterile products requires the following in addition to the general requirements:

blocks.zh: 加強取樣（Enhanced Sampling）：統計上有意義的批次內取樣，不能只取規格表規定的最低取樣數
blocks.en: Enhanced sampling: statistically meaningful within-batch sampling; it is not sufficient to take only the minimum number of samples stated in the specification

blocks.zh: APS（無菌工藝模擬）：PPQ 前必須完成培養基充填（Media Fill），且每條充填線需個別執行
blocks.en: APS (aseptic process simulation): media fills must be completed before PPQ, and must be performed separately for each filling line

blocks.zh: 同步驗證（Concurrent Validation）：在某些情況下，FDA 允許同步驗證，但需事先向主管機關說明理由並取得認可
blocks.en: Concurrent validation: in some cases the FDA allows concurrent validation, but the justification must be explained to and accepted by the regulatory authority in advance

blocks.zh: 為何無菌製劑 PPQ 的取樣計畫需要比口服固體劑型更複雜？
blocks.en: Why does the PPQ sampling plan for sterile products need to be more complex than for oral solid dosage forms?

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 在 PPQ 前未完成 APS，有什麼法規風險？
blocks.en: What regulatory risk does a CDMO face if APS is not completed before PPQ?

blocks.zh: Chapter 7 — Quality Aspects of Technology Transfer（技術轉移的品質面向）
blocks.en: Chapter 7 - Quality Aspects of Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 7.1 Introduction 7.1 簡介
blocks.en: 7.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 第七章的架構邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Structural Logic of Chapter 7

blocks.zh: 第七章從「品質系統」的角度審視技術轉移，涵蓋七個面向：
blocks.en: Chapter 7 examines technology transfer from a quality system perspective and covers seven aspects:

blocks.zh: QA 的角色定位（不只是審核，要主動參與）
blocks.en: The role of QA (not just reviewing, but participating actively)

blocks.zh: QbD 文件的轉移（QTPP、CQA、設計空間如何跨廠）
blocks.en: Transfer of QbD documentation (how QTPP, CQAs and design space move between sites)

blocks.zh: QRM 的應用（ICH Q9 工具在 TT 的具體應用）
blocks.en: Application of QRM (specific use of ICH Q9 tools in TT)

blocks.zh: 分析比較性（送方與受方產品是否等同）
blocks.en: Analytical comparability (whether the sending and receiving units' products are equivalent)

blocks.zh: PPQ 策略（法規對齊）
blocks.en: PPQ strategy (regulatory alignment)

blocks.zh: 變更管理（TT 如何分類為法規變更）
blocks.en: Change management (how a TT is classified as a regulatory change)

blocks.zh: 執行品質監督（TT 期間的品質文化）
blocks.en: Quality oversight during execution (quality culture during TT)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 階段適用性
blocks.en: Key Point - Applicability by Stage

blocks.zh: ISPE 提醒：這七個面向不一定全部適用於每一個轉移案。臨床早期（Phase 1-2）的轉移，設計空間可能尚未建立，就不需要「設計空間轉移」；商業後轉移則每個面向都必須完整執行。團隊需根據產品生命週期階段，判斷哪些是必要、哪些是建議執行。
blocks.en: ISPE cautions that not all seven aspects apply to every transfer. In an early clinical (Phase 1-2) transfer, the design space may not yet have been established, so no "design space transfer" is needed; a post-commercialization transfer requires every aspect to be fully executed. The team should decide, based on the product lifecycle stage, which are necessary and which are recommended.

blocks.zh: 7.2 Quality Representation on the Technology Transfer Team 7.2 技術轉移團隊中的品質代表
blocks.en: 7.2 Quality Representation on the Technology Transfer Team

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — QA 在 TT 團隊中的雙重角色
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Dual Role of QA on the TT Team

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調 QA 必須是 TT 核心團隊的成員，而不是後期審核者。QA 的兩個角色：
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that QA must be a member of the core TT team, not a late-stage reviewer. QA has two roles:

blocks.zh: 主動參與（Active Participation）：在風險評估、技術包審查、變更分類等決策中提供品質視角
blocks.en: Active participation: providing the quality perspective in decisions such as risk assessment, technology package review and change classification

blocks.zh: 獨立審查（Independent Review）：在 PPQ 數據審核、批次放行中維持獨立性
blocks.en: Independent review: maintaining independence in PPQ data review and batch release

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 QA 代表需要對送方的品質系統有足夠理解，才能識別差距。
blocks.en: The CDMO's QA representative needs a sufficient understanding of the sending unit's quality system to identify gaps.

blocks.zh: QA 在技術轉移中的角色就像飛機上的副駕駛——不是只在起飛前和落地後出現，而是全程參與飛行決策。若只在 PPQ 報告送到桌上才讓 QA 介入，就像飛行途中才叫副駕駛進駕駛艙，錯誤無法即時糾正。
blocks.en: The role of QA in technology transfer is like that of a co-pilot on an aircraft: not appearing only before takeoff and after landing, but taking part in flight decisions throughout. Involving QA only when the PPQ report lands on the desk is like calling the co-pilot into the cockpit in mid-flight, when errors can no longer be corrected in real time.

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 的 QA 代表在技術轉移初期缺席風險評估會議，可能帶來哪些後果？
blocks.en: What consequences could arise if the CDMO's QA representative is absent from risk assessment meetings at the start of a technology transfer?

blocks.zh: 在資源有限的中小型 CDMO，如何確保 QA 的「主動參與」不被排擠？
blocks.en: In a small or mid-sized CDMO with limited resources, how can you ensure that QA's "active participation" is not squeezed out?

blocks.zh: 7.3 Quality by Design and Control Strategy 7.3 品質源於設計與管制策略
blocks.en: 7.3 Quality by Design and Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — QbD 文件的轉移挑戰
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Challenges in Transferring QbD Documentation

blocks.zh: QTPP（目標產品品質概要）：定義最終產品應有的品質特性，通常隨藥品一起轉移，受方需確認其設備能生產出符合 QTPP 的產品。
blocks.en: QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile): defines the quality characteristics the final product should have. It is usually transferred together with the product, and the receiving unit must confirm that its equipment can produce a product that meets the QTPP.

blocks.zh: 設計空間（Design Space）的問題：設計空間是在送方的設備上建立的。受方的設備不同，同樣的參數範圍不一定適用。ISPE 的立場是：受方需要「証明」其設備能操作在相同的設計空間內，而非直接繼承設計空間。
blocks.en: The design space problem: the design space was established on the sending unit's equipment. Because the receiving unit's equipment is different, the same parameter ranges do not necessarily apply. ISPE's position is that the receiving unit needs to demonstrate that its equipment can operate within the same design space, rather than simply inheriting it.

blocks.zh: CQA 的轉移：這是相對直接的部分——CQA 是基於產品科學，不依賴特定設備，可以完整轉移。
blocks.en: Transfer of CQAs: this is the relatively straightforward part. CQAs are based on product science and do not depend on particular equipment, so they can be transferred in full.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 最小化變更的原則
blocks.en: Key Point - The Principle of Minimizing Change

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確建議：技術轉移期間，變更越少、成功率越高。這對 CDMO 有直接的商業含義：
blocks.en: ISPE clearly recommends that during technology transfer, the fewer the changes, the higher the success rate. This has a direct commercial implication for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 不要因為受方的設備習慣而主動修改製程
blocks.en: Do not modify the process on your own initiative to suit the receiving unit's equipment habits

blocks.zh: 原料商變更必須進行相容性評估，不能直接替換
blocks.en: A change of raw material supplier requires a compatibility assessment and cannot simply be substituted

blocks.zh: 若分析方法必須變更，等同性研究（Equivalency Study）是強制要求，不是選項
blocks.en: If an analytical method must change, an equivalency study is mandatory, not optional

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 設計空間轉移
blocks.en: Analogy - Design Space Transfer

blocks.zh: 設計空間就像一份菜單上「鹹度範圍 6-8 分」的標準。這個標準是在特定廚房的爐具上測試出來的。換了新廚房，即使用同樣的食材，也需要重新測試新爐具在同樣的參數設定下是否能做出 6-8 分鹹的料理。直接套用舊標準而不驗證，是重大的品質風險。
blocks.en: A design space is like a menu standard of "saltiness range 6-8". That standard was tested on the stove of a specific kitchen. In a new kitchen, even with the same ingredients, you need to retest whether the new stove at the same settings can still produce a dish rated 6-8 in saltiness. Applying the old standard directly without verification is a major quality risk.

blocks.zh: 若送方已在 CMC 文件中登記了設計空間，受方 CDMO 能否直接沿用此設計空間？需要做什麼才能合法使用？
blocks.en: If the sending unit has already registered a design space in the CMC dossier, can the receiving CDMO simply continue to use it? What must be done to use it legitimately?

blocks.zh: 分析方法從送方轉移到受方時，需要進行哪些確認才算完成「方法轉移」？
blocks.en: When an analytical method is transferred from the sending unit to the receiving unit, what confirmations are needed before the "method transfer" can be considered complete?

blocks.zh: 7.4 Quality Risk Management 7.4 品質風險管理
blocks.en: 7.4 Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — TT 中的 QRM 工具選擇
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Choosing QRM Tools in TT

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出多種 QRM 工具，各有適用場景：
blocks.en: ISPE lists several QRM tools, each suited to different situations:

blocks.zh: Fishbone（魚骨圖）：適合識別導致 CQA 偏差的根本原因；適用於轉移初期的問題識別
blocks.en: Fishbone: suited to identifying the root causes of CQA deviations; useful for problem identification early in the transfer

blocks.zh: FMEA（失效模式影響分析）：適合製程步驟逐一分析；提供嚴重性/發生率/檢出率的量化風險評分
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): suited to analyzing process steps one by one; provides a quantitative risk score based on severity, occurrence and detectability

blocks.zh: Cause-Effect Matrix（因果矩陣）：連接製程參數與 CQA；識別哪些參數對哪些品質屬性影響最大
blocks.en: Cause-Effect Matrix: links process parameters to CQAs; identifies which parameters have the greatest impact on which quality attributes

blocks.zh: Gap Analysis（缺口分析）：比較送方與受方的差異；適合 Section 5 的表格格式
blocks.en: Gap Analysis: compares the differences between the sending and receiving units; suited to the tabular format of Section 5

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 風險登記冊（Risk Register）
blocks.en: Key Point - The Risk Register

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議使用統一的風險登記冊（Risk Register）追蹤所有高風險項目的緩解狀態。這是 GMP 稽查中最常被要求查看的文件之一。風險登記冊應包含：
blocks.en: ISPE recommends using a single Risk Register to track the mitigation status of all high-risk items. It is one of the documents most often requested for review during GMP inspections. The risk register should include:

blocks.zh: 風險描述與分類（技術/法規/商業）
blocks.en: Risk description and category (technical / regulatory / commercial)

blocks.zh: 初始風險評分（severity × occurrence × detectability）
blocks.en: Initial risk score (severity × occurrence × detectability)

blocks.zh: 緩解措施與責任人
blocks.en: Mitigation actions and owners

blocks.zh: 緩解後剩餘風險評分
blocks.en: Residual risk score after mitigation

blocks.zh: 關閉狀態與日期
blocks.en: Closure status and date

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌 CDMO 的特殊風險項目
blocks.en: Key Point - Special Risk Items for a Sterile CDMO

blocks.zh: 針對無菌多品種設施（Multi-Product Facility），以下風險需要獨立的評估文件：
blocks.en: For a sterile multi-product facility, the following risks require separate assessment documents:

blocks.zh: 交叉污染風險：同一設施同時生產多個產品時，需確認設備清潔驗證覆蓋新產品
blocks.en: Cross-contamination risk: when several products are made in the same facility, confirm that equipment cleaning validation covers the new product

blocks.zh: 隔離風險：無菌區的人流/物流設計是否支持新產品的生產動線
blocks.en: Segregation risk: whether the personnel and material flow design of the aseptic area supports the production flow of the new product

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 對齊：污染控制策略（CCS）需要對應新產品的特定風險
blocks.en: Alignment with EU GMP Annex 1: the contamination control strategy (CCS) must address the specific risks of the new product

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的多品種無菌設施中，接受新品種轉移時，哪三種風險評估是絕對必要的？
blocks.en: In a CDMO's multi-product sterile facility, which three risk assessments are absolutely necessary when accepting the transfer of a new product?

blocks.zh: 「Fit-for-use 評估」與「設備認定（Equipment Qualification）」的區別是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the difference between a "fit-for-use assessment" and "equipment qualification"?

blocks.zh: 7.5 Analytical Comparability / Similarity and Stability Strategy 7.5 分析可比性/相似性與安定性策略
blocks.en: 7.5 Analytical Comparability / Similarity and Stability Strategy

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 比較性（Comparability）的法規定義
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The Regulatory Definition of Comparability

blocks.zh: 分析比較性（Analytical Comparability）是指：在製程變更前後，透過分析方法証明產品品質屬性保持相似或等同，以確保患者的安全性與療效不受影響。
blocks.en: Analytical comparability means demonstrating, by analytical methods, that product quality attributes remain similar or equivalent before and after a process change, so as to ensure that patient safety and efficacy are not affected.

blocks.zh: 法規依據：ICH Q5E（生物製劑）是最明確的指南，要求比較：
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: ICH Q5E (for biological products) is the clearest guideline, and it requires comparison of:

blocks.zh: 理化特性（分子量、等電點、糖型分析）
blocks.en: Physicochemical properties (molecular weight, isoelectric point, glycoform analysis)

blocks.zh: 生物活性（效力、受體親和力）
blocks.en: Biological activity (potency, receptor affinity)

blocks.zh: 免疫化學特性（抗原性）
blocks.en: Immunochemical properties (antigenicity)

blocks.zh: 雜質 profile（製程相關雜質和產品相關雜質）
blocks.en: Impurity profile (process-related impurities and product-related impurities)

blocks.zh: 對小分子製劑，比較性要求相對簡單，但同樣需要制訂明確的接受標準。
blocks.en: For small-molecule products the comparability requirements are relatively simple, but clear acceptance criteria are still needed.

blocks.zh: 比較性策略設計原則
blocks.en: Comparability Strategy Design Principles

blocks.zh:
生命週期階段 vs. 比較性要求強度：

Phase 1-2 TT:
  → 有限的比較性數據
  → 重點：少量批次確認理化等同
  → 不要求臨床橋接

Phase 3 TT (Pre-pivotal):
  → 完整的比較性數據組
  → 要求放行測試 + 特性化測試
  → 加速穩定性試驗支持

Commercial TT (Post-approval):
  → 最嚴格要求
  → 可能觸發法規申報（CBE-30 / PAS）
  → 多批次數據確認一致性
  → 穩定性橋接研究
blocks.en:
Lifecycle stage vs. strength of comparability requirements:

Phase 1-2 TT:
  → Limited comparability data
  → Focus: confirm physicochemical equivalence with a small number of batches
  → Clinical bridging not required

Phase 3 TT (Pre-pivotal):
  → Full comparability data set
  → Release testing + characterization testing required
  → Supported by accelerated stability studies

Commercial TT (Post-approval):
  → Most stringent requirements
  → May trigger a regulatory filing (CBE-30 / PAS)
  → Multiple batches to confirm consistency
  → Stability bridging study

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 接受標準必須前瞻性設定
blocks.en: Key Point - Acceptance Criteria Must Be Set Prospectively

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調：比較性的接受標準必須在實驗開始之前就設定好（Prospective），不能等到看到數據後才決定標準。這是最常見的 GMP 違規之一——「看到數據不好才調整接受標準」是不可接受的做法，在 FDA 483 觀察項和 EMA 缺陷中屢見不鮮。
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that comparability acceptance criteria must be set before the experiment begins (prospectively) and cannot be decided after seeing the data. This is one of the most common GMP violations: adjusting acceptance criteria after seeing poor data is unacceptable and appears repeatedly in FDA 483 observations and EMA deficiencies.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 異常比較性結果的處理
blocks.en: Key Point - Handling Abnormal Comparability Results

blocks.zh: 若比較性數據出現異常結果，調查邏輯應為：
blocks.en: If comparability data show an abnormal result, the investigation logic should be:

blocks.zh: 確認是否為分析誤差（重測、方法確認）
blocks.en: Confirm whether it is an analytical error (retest, method verification)

blocks.zh: 若確認是真實差異，評估對患者安全性和療效的影響
blocks.en: If a true difference is confirmed, assess the impact on patient safety and efficacy

blocks.zh: 判斷是否需要額外非臨床或臨床研究
blocks.en: Determine whether additional nonclinical or clinical studies are needed

blocks.zh: 決定該批次是否仍可用於比較性目的（即使不能放行）
blocks.en: Decide whether the batch can still be used for comparability purposes (even if it cannot be released)

blocks.zh: 不合格的比較性批次並不自動等於廢棄——其分析數據可能仍具有科學意義，需逐案判斷。
blocks.en: A failed comparability batch is not automatically discarded: its analytical data may still have scientific value and must be judged case by case.

blocks.zh: 為何比較性接受標準必須前瞻性設定？若在看到數據後才設定，有什麼法規後果？
blocks.en: Why must comparability acceptance criteria be set prospectively? What are the regulatory consequences if they are set after seeing the data?

blocks.zh: 一個被拒絕放行的比較性批次，其分析數據是否仍可用於比較性評估？如何判斷？
blocks.en: Can the analytical data from a comparability batch that was rejected for release still be used in the comparability assessment? How would you decide?

blocks.zh: 7.6 Process Validation / Process Performance Qualification Strategy 7.6 製程驗證 / 製程性能確效策略
blocks.en: 7.6 Process Validation / Process Performance Qualification Strategy

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 多法規框架的對齊
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Alignment Across Multiple Regulatory Frameworks

blocks.zh: ISPE 要求技術轉移的 PPQ 策略必須對齊多個法規指南，因為同一個 CDMO 可能同時生產面向美國（FDA）和歐洲（EMA）市場的產品：
blocks.en: ISPE requires the PPQ strategy for a technology transfer to align with multiple regulatory guidelines, because the same CDMO may produce products for both the US (FDA) and European (EMA) markets:

blocks.zh: FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance：三階段框架，強調持續製程驗證（CPV）；無菌製劑要求加強取樣
blocks.en: FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance: a three-stage framework that emphasizes continued process verification (CPV); enhanced sampling is expected for sterile products

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15（2015）：明確要求 PPQ 報告，規定同步驗證（Concurrent Validation）的條件
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15 (2015): explicitly requires a PPQ report and specifies the conditions for concurrent validation

blocks.zh: EMA 生物製劑驗證指南：對比較性數據要求更嚴，特別是糖型分析
blocks.en: EMA guideline on validation for biological products: places stricter demands on comparability data, particularly glycoform analysis

blocks.zh: ICH Q7：API 廠的驗證要求，適用於藥物活性成分的轉移
blocks.en: ICH Q7: validation requirements for API manufacturers, applicable to the transfer of active substances

blocks.zh: 無菌製劑 PPQ 策略摘要
blocks.en: Summary of PPQ Strategy for Sterile Products

blocks.zh:
標準 PPQ 要求（FDA + EU 對齊）：
  批次數量：最少 3 批（FDA 建議，不是強制）
  批次規模：商業批規模（不得縮小）
  取樣要求：統計上有意義的加強取樣

無菌製劑額外要求：
  APS（培養基充填）：PPQ 前完成
  CCI 確認：每批 PPQ 均需執行
  無菌測試：依 Ph. Eur. 2.6.1 / USP <71>

同步驗證（Concurrent Validation）條件：
  → 製程已有充足歷史數據
  → 已向主管機關說明並取得認可
  → 需有加強的即時監測計畫
  → 完整 PPQ 必須在商業批次數量
    達到設定值後回顧確認
blocks.en:
Standard PPQ requirements (FDA + EU aligned):
  Number of batches: at least 3 (FDA recommendation, not mandatory)
  Batch size: commercial scale (must not be reduced)
  Sampling: statistically meaningful enhanced sampling

Additional requirements for sterile products:
  APS (media fill): completed before PPQ
  CCI confirmation: performed for every PPQ batch
  Sterility test: per Ph. Eur. 2.6.1 / USP <71>

Conditions for concurrent validation:
  → The process has sufficient historical data
  → The justification has been explained to and accepted by the regulatory authority
  → An enhanced real-time monitoring plan is in place
  → Full PPQ must be confirmed retrospectively once the number
    of commercial batches reaches the defined value

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 的商業壓力 vs. 法規要求
blocks.en: Key Point - CDMO Commercial Pressure vs. Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 技術轉移中最常見的衝突：客戶要求「第一批就商業放行」，但法規要求完整的 PPQ 流程。CDMO QA 的責任是：在接案合約中明確約定 PPQ 批次數量與策略，避免後期在製程驗證策略上產生爭議。若客戶堅持同步驗證，必須確保有法規依據支持，並在 NDA/MAA 中事先申報。
blocks.en: The most common conflict in technology transfer is a client asking for "commercial release from the first batch" when the regulations require the full PPQ process. The CDMO QA's responsibility is to agree on the number of PPQ batches and the strategy explicitly in the project contract, to avoid later disputes over the process validation strategy. If the client insists on concurrent validation, it must be supported by a regulatory basis and declared in advance in the NDA/MAA.

blocks.zh: 「同步驗證（Concurrent Validation）」在何種條件下才是可接受的？對無菌製劑是否有特殊限制？
blocks.en: Under what conditions is concurrent validation acceptable? Are there special restrictions for sterile products?

blocks.zh: 若 FDA 和 EMA 對 PPQ 批次數量的要求不同，CDMO 應如何制訂滿足兩個市場的 PPQ 策略？
blocks.en: If the FDA and EMA have different requirements for the number of PPQ batches, how should a CDMO design a PPQ strategy that satisfies both markets?

blocks.zh: 7.7 Change Management（變更管理）
blocks.en: 7.7 Change Management

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 分類必須在執行前完成
blocks.en: Key Point - Classification Must Be Completed Before Execution

blocks.zh: ISPE 的明確立場：法規分類必須在技術轉移執行前完成，不是執行後。若在 PPQ 完成後才發現需要 PAS（需要 FDA 批准才能生產），而生產計畫已排定，將面臨重大的商業損失。
blocks.en: ISPE's position is clear: regulatory classification must be completed before the technology transfer is executed, not afterward. If it is discovered after PPQ is completed that a PAS (requiring FDA approval before manufacture) is needed, and the production plan has already been scheduled, the commercial loss will be significant.

blocks.zh: QA 的責任清單：
blocks.en: QA's list of responsibilities:

blocks.zh: 在接案時就啟動法規分類評估
blocks.en: Start the regulatory classification assessment at project intake

blocks.zh: 確認是否需要 prior approval，並與法規事務（RA）部門協同確認
blocks.en: Confirm whether prior approval is needed, working together with the Regulatory Affairs (RA) department

blocks.zh: 在合約中明確告知客戶申報時程和限制
blocks.en: State the filing timeline and constraints to the client clearly in the contract

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — TT 完成點的明確定義
blocks.en: Key Point - A Clear Definition of the TT Completion Point

blocks.zh: 技術轉移何時算「完成」？CDMO 與送方必須在合約中明確約定：
blocks.en: When is a technology transfer "complete"? The CDMO and the sending unit must agree this explicitly in the contract:

blocks.zh: PPQ 報告核准後？
blocks.en: After approval of the PPQ report?

blocks.zh: 第一個商業批次放行後？
blocks.en: After release of the first commercial batch?

blocks.zh: 第一次法規稽查通過後？
blocks.en: After the first successful regulatory inspection?

blocks.zh: 轉移完成點定義了技術責任的移交時刻——完成點之前，送方 SME 仍有技術支援義務；完成點之後，CDMO 承擔全部生產責任。
blocks.en: The completion point defines the moment technical responsibility is handed over: before it, the sending unit's SMEs remain obliged to provide technical support; after it, the CDMO bears full responsibility for manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 接案風險管理
blocks.en: Practical Application - CDMO Risk Management on Project Intake

blocks.zh: CDMO 商務開發（BD）在接受技術轉移報價時，必須要求 QA 和 RA 同步評估：
blocks.en: When CDMO Business Development (BD) is quoting for a technology transfer, QA and RA must be asked to assess in parallel:

blocks.zh: 這個 TT 屬於哪一類法規變更？
blocks.en: Which category of regulatory change does this TT fall under?

blocks.zh: 申報時程多長？對商業化時程有何影響？
blocks.en: How long is the filing timeline? What is the impact on the commercialization timeline?

blocks.zh: 需要哪些 CDMO 端的資料才能支持客戶的申報文件？
blocks.en: What CDMO-side data are needed to support the client's filing documents?

blocks.zh: 這些問題在簽約前回答，遠比簽約後發現問題的代價低。
blocks.en: Answering these questions before signing the contract costs far less than discovering problems after signing.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — TT 的法規變更分類
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Regulatory Change Classification of TT

blocks.zh: 技術轉移幾乎不可避免地會觸發法規申報，分類正確至關重要：
blocks.en: Technology transfer almost inevitably triggers a regulatory filing, so correct classification is critical:

blocks.zh: 7.8 Execution — Quality Oversight During TT 7.8 執行 — 技術轉移期間品質監督
blocks.en: 7.8 Execution - Quality Oversight During TT

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 執行期品質監督的四個面向
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Four Aspects of Quality Oversight During Execution

blocks.zh: TT 執行期間的品質監督不僅是「審核文件」，而是主動確保：
blocks.en: Quality oversight during TT execution is not just "reviewing documents"; it actively ensures:

blocks.zh: 即時偏差管理：TT 期間的偏差若未即時記錄，後期可能無法還原事件序列，影響 PPQ 數據的完整性
blocks.en: Real-time deviation management: if deviations during TT are not recorded promptly, the sequence of events may not be reconstructable later, affecting the integrity of PPQ data

blocks.zh: 決策品質：「是否繼續下一批次」等關鍵決策需要 QA 參與和簽核
blocks.en: Decision quality: key decisions such as "whether to proceed to the next batch" need QA participation and sign-off

blocks.zh: 知識捕獲：TT 產生的製程知識（包括「什麼不行」）必須被文件化，成為常規製造的知識庫
blocks.en: Knowledge capture: the process knowledge generated by TT (including "what does not work") must be documented and become the knowledge base for routine manufacturing

blocks.zh: 正式移交：從 TT 到商業製造的移交必須有正式的品質簽核文件，不能只是「PPQ 通過就繼續」
blocks.en: Formal handover: the handover from TT to commercial manufacturing must have formal quality sign-off documentation; it cannot be just "PPQ passed, so carry on"

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 知識捕獲的重要性
blocks.en: Analogy - The Importance of Knowledge Capture

blocks.zh: 技術轉移就像建設一棟大樓——過程中遇到的地基問題、工法調整、材料替換，如果都記錄在施工日誌裡，未來維修或改建時就有完整依據。如果只記「大樓已竣工」，將來出現問題時就無從追溯。TT 的文件就是這棟大樓的施工日誌。
blocks.en: A technology transfer is like constructing a building. If the foundation problems, construction method adjustments and material substitutions encountered along the way are all recorded in the site log, there is a complete basis for future repair or renovation. If only "building completed" is recorded, problems later cannot be traced. The TT documentation is the site log of this building.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 技術責任的移交時刻
blocks.en: Key Point - The Moment CDMO Technical Responsibility Is Handed Over

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調「TT 完成」的正式文件化是 CDMO 與客戶之間最重要的里程碑之一。完成點之後：
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that the formal documentation of "TT completion" is one of the most important milestones between the CDMO and the client. After the completion point:

blocks.zh: CDMO 承擔全部的 GMP 合規責任
blocks.en: The CDMO bears full GMP compliance responsibility

blocks.zh: 送方的技術支援義務轉為「諮詢」性質
blocks.en: The sending unit's technical support obligation becomes advisory in nature

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 QA 成為主要品質主管
blocks.en: The CDMO's QA becomes the primary quality authority

blocks.zh: 建議在 TT 合約中明確定義「移交條件（Handover Criteria）」，並要求雙方 QA 主管簽署移交確認書。
blocks.en: It is recommended that the TT contract clearly define the "Handover Criteria" and require the QA heads of both parties to sign a handover confirmation.

blocks.zh: 在技術轉移執行期間，如何確保偏差記錄的完整性，而不影響 PPQ 批次的使用？
blocks.en: During technology transfer execution, how can the completeness of deviation records be ensured without affecting the usability of the PPQ batches?

blocks.zh: 技術轉移「正式完成」的標準應包含哪些要素？如何在合約中明確界定？
blocks.en: What elements should the standard for "formal completion" of a technology transfer include? How can it be clearly defined in the contract?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Ch. 6 DP TT 範疇：無菌製劑的技術轉移涵蓋 HEPA 設施確認、容器密封系統等同性、過濾器驗證、APS 等額外考量，遠比口服固體劑型複雜
blocks.en: Ch. 6 DP TT scope: technology transfer of sterile products involves additional considerations such as HEPA facility confirmation, container-closure system equivalence, filter validation and APS, making it far more complex than oral solid dosage forms

blocks.zh: 技術包要求：DP 技術包需包含 BFD/PFD、批次記錄、製程特性化報告、E&L 資料、APS 歷史數據和凍乾曲線等，隱性知識需透過製程觀摩傳遞
blocks.en: Technology package requirements: the DP technology package must include BFD/PFD, batch records, process characterization reports, E&L data, historical APS data and lyophilization cycles, among others; tacit knowledge needs to be passed on through process observation

blocks.zh: PPQ 三前提：設施資格認定、分析方法轉移確認、APS 完成——三者缺一不可，缺少任一項都不應啟動 PPQ
blocks.en: The three PPQ prerequisites: facility qualification, confirmed analytical method transfer and completed APS. All three are essential, and PPQ should not be started if any one is missing

blocks.zh: QbD 轉移的核心矛盾：設計空間是在送方設備上建立的，受方不能直接「繼承」，必須證明其設備能操作在相同的設計空間範圍內
blocks.en: The core tension in QbD transfer: the design space was established on the sending unit's equipment and cannot simply be "inherited" by the receiving unit, which must demonstrate that its equipment can operate within the same design space range

blocks.zh: QRM 工具選擇：FMEA 適合製程步驟分析、Fishbone 適合根因識別、Risk Register 是追蹤緩解措施的主要工具，稽查時必查
blocks.en: Choosing QRM tools: FMEA suits process step analysis, Fishbone suits root cause identification, and the Risk Register is the main tool for tracking mitigation actions and is always requested in inspections

blocks.zh: 比較性接受標準：必須前瞻性設定（Prospective），不得在看到數據後再調整；生物製劑需對齊 ICH Q5E 要求
blocks.en: Comparability acceptance criteria: must be set prospectively and may not be adjusted after seeing the data; biological products must align with ICH Q5E requirements

blocks.zh: 變更管理先行：法規分類（PAS/CBE-30/Type II）必須在 TT 執行前完成，由 QA 和 RA 協同判斷，避免 PPQ 完成後才發現申報障礙
blocks.en: Change management first: regulatory classification (PAS/CBE-30/Type II) must be completed before TT execution, determined jointly by QA and RA, to avoid discovering a filing obstacle only after PPQ is complete

blocks.zh: CDMO 責任移交：TT 完成點需在合約中明確定義，並以雙方 QA 主管簽署的移交確認書作為正式里程碑
blocks.en: CDMO handover of responsibility: the TT completion point must be clearly defined in the contract, with a handover confirmation signed by the QA heads of both parties as the formal milestone
